title: When 3D design feels alive — Meet Genevieve
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/68b1bf1f4b1b422a9c9d549de99caf62/images/07d83af28cd7438c9805ea6afc861028jewel%20rendering%20with%20pose%200353%201920.png)Hi everyone,  
last time I mentioned that I was developing a close-up motion piece capturing my virtual muse Genevieve’s subtle expressions and gestures.

This short video focuses on those small, lifelike moments — the way she shifts her pose, the softness in her gaze, and the quiet presence that emerges when animation is layered onto a fully original 3D design.

Genevieve isn’t AI-redesigned; she moves with the textures, shapes, and colors I created.  
Each motion is added only to bring her to life, not to alter the design.

You can watch the full short video here:

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uBg7nvrpx-s?start=0

title: CLO LIVE SYNC
content:
Hi everyone,

I’m trying to install **CLO Live Sync** on **Unreal Engine** , and even though I’ve followed every installation step carefully, the **“Live Sync”** option never appears in Unreal.

I’ve already tried:

  * reinstalling the plugin,

  * restarting Unreal Engine,

  * checking version compatibility,

  * re-importing the plugin folders,

  * enabling/re-enabling the plugin in the settings,

  * rebooting the PC…




the option still doesn’t show up anywhere in Unreal...

Has anyone dealt with this issue before or knows how to fix it?  
Any help would be greatly appreciated!  
Best

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi imometh,Does the LiveSync mode not appear under Selection Mode?Best regards,Bryan

Comment 2: Have you ever pressed select mode in Unreal engine?
content_description: A community forum page for troubleshooting and resolving issues with the CLO Live Sync plugin not appearing in Unreal Engine.

title: Graphics has square around it
content:
I have loaded a graphic onto a garment but it seems to show a black background despite the graphic being a PNG with a transparent back ground. I have ensured the graphic has the same normal map as the fabric. Would appreciate any tips on how to avoid this. ![9fd94833079c4980a19f41a9a9c2a0ba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/0b7abb48abae4df5828382b864b5c723/images/9fd94833079c4980a19f41a9a9c2a0baCaptureLogo.PNG)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, it's a known bug and is currently being fixed.Please download a previous version of CLO (https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/0b7abb48abae4df5828382b864b5c723 Otherwise, some users mention that it can be resolved by activating the "Shadow Render" option in the graphic's property editor. Sorry for the inconvenience!

title: clo problem
content:
Hello, has anyone experienced issues with the simulation feature in Clo3D for Mac? Since the latest update, the simulation option stops working and does not allow me to simulate my garment. The only way to make it work is by closing and reopening the software, and it only lets me simulate once. After that, I have to restart the program again in order to continue viewing the progress of my garment. Is there any known fix or workaround for this issue?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: CLO3D simulation does not start consistently. In most cases, the simulation starts only after 3–4 attempts, or does not start at all, even with very simple garments constructed in 2D. The issue occurs during fitting and simulation preview.
Reply 1: Hi, please check your specs against the system requirements https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4 If you are using windows, could you check if your GPU is set to high performace? https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4 Please get back to us if this helps.

Comment 2: Hi There. We are sorry to hear you are having this issue. Please send in a ticket direct to our Tech Support teamhttps://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4
content_description: This web page serves to gather user experiences and solutions regarding simulation feature issues in Clo3D for Mac following the latest update.

title: Fabric can't display thumbnail image
content:
Why can't the preview image be displayed when the mouse hovers over the fabric?Like this example 👇![2b9d89ed09f14877aba4def03285401c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/a1c995c6f66f4b77bb224c6408bd9930/images/2b9d89ed09f14877aba4def03285401c1000059191.jpg)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, it is intended behavior for the docked library to not show the preview. You can still see it in the undocked library when the "i" section is being displayed. (see screenshot) However, we have already noted this down to be possible / changed as we agree that it is useful to have. So please excuse the inconvenience, we hope it is soon changed for a future patch! :)

content_description: This page explains common reasons why fabric preview images may not display on mouse hover and how to troubleshoot the issue.
